 Oklahoma City plays Denver in conference matchup 
 Denver takes on Oklahoma City for a Western Conference matchup Thursday 
 1:21 By The Associated Press October 21, 2026, 2:04 AM Share Follow ABC News on Google Denver Nuggets vs. Oklahoma City Thunder
 Oklahoma City; Thursday, 9:30 p.m. EDT
 LINE: Thunder -8.5; over/under is 236.5
 BOTTOM LINE: Western Conference foes Oklahoma City and Denver square off.
 Oklahoma City went 64-18 overall and 12-4 in Northwest Division action last season. The Thunder averaged 119.0 points per game last season, 19.0 on free throws and 41.4 from beyond the arc.
 Denver finished 54-28 overall and 36-16 in Western Conference action during the 2025-26 season. The Nuggets averaged 29.0 assists per game on 43.5 made field goals last season.
